title: Mutsvaki Akasimba weChokwadi
intro: Munguva yakafukidzwa nekusaziva uye kunamata vanamwari venhema, rwendo rukuru rwekutenda rwakamuka. Munhu uyu akapikisa tsika dzenzanga yavo, achitsvaga Musiki Mumwe Chete wechokwadi nechivimbo chisingazununguki. Gadzirira kuburitsa pachena hunhu hwemweya une nhaka inoramba ichikurudzira mamiriyoni.
clues: Ndakabvunza nezvezvinhu zviri kudenga, ndichitsvaga Ishe wechokwadi anogadzira uye anotsigira zvese.
Ndakarayirwa kuti ndibve munyika yangu, ndichienda kunyika yakaropafadzwa naAllah.
Ndakapikisa zvidhori zvevanhu vangu, ndichitarisana nekusabatsira kwazvo nekuzviputsa.
Ndakakandwa mumoto waipfuta nevanhu vangu, asi zvakava zvinotonhorera uye zvine rugare kwandiri nemurairo waAllah.
Ndakaedzwa nemurairo wekuti ndibayire mwanakomana wangu wedangwe wandinoda, muedzo wekuzviisa pasi pemutemo wekupedzisira.
Ini, pamwe chete nemwanakomana wangu, takavaka nheyo dzeImba yekutanga yekunamatira pasi pano, nzvimbo tsvene yevanhu vose.
arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verse: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham." (21:69)
